name: The Nexus
hint: One door still glows. Go to it.
rule: Each idea you understand lights a star. Each book you master raises a column of the Tower.

restores.line: A small fire kindles at the foot of the Tower.
The broken way to Greece knits itself whole.
The door of Greece burns warm again.
A little colour seeps back into the void.
The shades at the edge lift their heads, and sing.
The Greek tier of the Tower stands whole.

star: A new star burns in the dark.
stars: {n} new stars burn in the dark.
column: A column of the Tower stands again ({k} of 17).
columns: {n} columns of the Tower stand again ({k} of 17).
